note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items
Spreadsheet sheet tab list -- renders operator-defined sheet names (e.g., Sheet1, Sheet2) which are part of the document structure and not external UGC
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for formatting and editing controls (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Bold, Italic, etc.)
Application status bar -- renders fixed operator labels and computed status indicators (e.g., 'Ready', 'Normal', 'English (USA)')
